schemes.update: replace the Euclidean prox with a Bregman prox D_h; for the nonnegative orthant h = negative entropy gives multiplicative primal updates

schemes.notes: FRONTIER, IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-10 as base scheme pdhg_entropic (not yet a genome scheme gene; reachable through build_scheme). GATE FINDING: the entropy kernel admits a step condition only where the constraints imply a simplex; the transport families declare it (sum x = 1) and get t*s*||L||_{1->2}^2 < 1 with ||L||_{1->2} = sqrt(2), size independent, where the Euclidean gate is t*s*(m+n) < 1. The plain standard-form LP orthant and the QP cell are rejected. DUAL RECOVERY required: the redundant simplex multiplier never enters u, so the certified dual is u - min(c + L^T u) w_S (w_S = source indicator); without it the LP gap stalls at 0.93.

schemes.name: Solodov-Svaiter hybrid projection-proximal step

original.authors: M. V. Solodov and B. F. Svaiter
original.title: A hybrid projection-proximal point algorithm

schemes.update: inexact prox step gives y_k and v_k in the operator at y_k; then project x_k onto the separating hyperplane: x_{k+1} = x_k - (<v_k, x_k - y_k> / ||v_k||^2) v_k
schemes.side_condition: relative error ||e_k|| <= sigma * max(||v_k||, ||x_k - y_k||), sigma in [0,1)
schemes.guarantee: weak global convergence, local linear rate; the projection costs nothing extra and permits loose inner solves

measured.dotmark_ot_2026-09-10: Plain PDHG on DOTmark (4090, reduction operator): a fixed ratio grid r in [0.03, 30] certified NOTHING in 5e4 iterations (the plan sat at zero).
